ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.

7. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food/ PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food/ PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Food/ PRACTICES.

10. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

11. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Toileting PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Toileting PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Toileting PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Toileting PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Toileting PRACTICES.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain People found at home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to; and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Dressing ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

5. D — Ice melting to water
